entry_contract.sha256: required for add/modify; absent for delete
entry_contract.owner_units: ordered non-empty array drawn from: audited-baseline | U0 | U1 | U2 | U3 | U4 | U5 | U6 | U7 | U8 | U9; append an owner when the same path changes again
entry_contract.control_rule: manifest self-digest is forbidden; execution-log and current-status digests are written only after the content gate and verified by --control-seal; control files must not be execution, build, package-metadata, or test-discovery inputs
